topography.project_purpose: RWA Lending. Structurally: 17 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 3 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (kasuaccesscontrollable, assetfunctionsbase, lendingpoolhelpers). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
